facts.value: Most students take a dual subject pathway where they can combine two subjects.
Subject selection will depend on applicants having studied relevant pre-requisite modules or a similar stream as part of their associate degree.
If subjects are in the same group, they clash, so they cannot be taken together.

Students on the advanced access pathway should disregard the modules shown for years 1 and 2 (semesters 1 to 4) of each subject and instead look at the modules offered in years 3 and 4 (semesters 6 to 8).
Semester 5 is marked as Erasmus/Exchange; however, students on the advanced access pathway will use that semester as an opportunity to take suitable modules on campus.
Students can take Sociology or Politics and International Relations as single honours pathways.
Students can focus entirely on Sociology or Politics and International Relations if they wish.
